review.body_prefix: Thanks for the substantial Laser Pointer implementation and the follow-up fixes. Several correctness, integration, and privacy issues remain in the upstream head; please address the review notes below before merging.

proposed_comments.title: Keep pen input mapped and isolated
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep pen input mapped and isolated

**Severity:** `high`

The upstream implementation uses the raw-input device handle directly with the pointer-device APIs and makes the full-screen overlay non-transparent while a pen is in range. Those behaviors can map a pen to the unrelated mouse cursor and let the overlay intercept mouse input over unrelated applications. Resolve the raw HID to the supported pointer-device representation, and keep the rendering overlay click-through while using a bounded input-only capture region for pen input.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The required correction spans the raw-input mapping, pointer-device lookup, window styles, and the separate capture window; it is not safely representable as one current RIGHT-side suggestion.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The required correction spans the raw-input mapping, pointer-device lookup, window styles, and the separate capture window; it is not safely representable as one current RIGHT-side suggestion.

confidence.rationale: The latest fork Copilot passes identified both incompatible handle domains and full-screen hit-testing risk; the converged fork contains targeted fixes for both paths.

proposed_comments.title: Preserve the active share when retargeting fails
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve the active share when retargeting fails

**Severity:** `high`

Retargeting stops and destroys the current presenter before the replacement capture has successfully started. If the selected window is protected, elevated, or otherwise uncapturable, a failed retarget therefore ends an otherwise working share. Stage the replacement capture first and replace the existing session only after it succeeds. Also allow valid untitled windows through and use the existing localized untitled fallback when refreshing the presenter title.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The fix requires coordinated lifetime and failure-path changes in presenter startup, retargeting, and title refresh rather than a safe single-line replacement.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The fix requires coordinated lifetime and failure-path changes in presenter startup, retargeting, and title refresh rather than a safe single-line replacement.

confidence.rationale: Copilot identified the destructive retarget order and unreachable untitled-window fallback; the fork fixes preserve the existing session and restore the fallback path.

proposed_comments.title: Do not truncate configured stroke decay
proposed_comments.body:
### Do not truncate configured stroke decay

**Severity:** `medium`

The fixed 4,096-sample cap can truncate valid trails for the supported ten-second decay and high-rate input, making the configured tail and fade materially shorter. Bound retained samples by the currently scaled decay length, with a defensive upper bound only where needed for pathological input rates.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The correction depends on the decay-length calculation and retention policy in the stroke model, not one independently safe line in the upstream diff.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The correction depends on the decay-length calculation and retention policy in the stroke model, not one independently safe line in the upstream diff.

confidence.rationale: The fork Copilot pass quantified the mismatch between the fixed cap and the configured decay behavior, and the converged fork adjusts retention accordingly.

proposed_comments.title: Complete integration and diagnostic coverage
proposed_comments.body:
### Complete integration and diagnostic coverage

**Severity:** `medium`

Before merging, include the module in the existing integration surfaces: Shortcut Guide should enumerate its configured shortcuts, and Bug Report Tool policy output should report the new GPO. Pen activation should emit the documented session telemetry, the overlay worker should initialize its own WinRT apartment before using WinRT APIs, and the presenter must avoid logging user-controlled window titles. Add the focused Mouse Utilities lifecycle, settings, activation, and presenter coverage called out by the review loop, or document the exact manual validation that covers those paths.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: These are separate cross-file integration, telemetry, diagnostics, privacy, threading, and test-surface changes; combining them into an inline suggestion would not produce a safe or complete patch.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: These are separate cross-file integration, telemetry, diagnostics, privacy, threading, and test-surface changes; combining them into an inline suggestion would not produce a safe or complete patch.

confidence.rationale: The findings were independently raised across the converged Copilot review history and are represented by concrete fork-side changes or explicitly retained coverage work.
